messages:
sasha: quick RFC follow-up  proposing a lightweight 'shadow-probe' pattern for API shape migrations. goal: observe transforms without impacting traffic.
rita: ok, what's the minimal contract?
sasha: minimal: 1) probe header X-RW-Shadow: probe 2) edge mirrors response to comparer service while returning original 3) telemetry: compat.shadow.probe, compat.shadow.apply, compat.shadow.revert 4) per-tenant opt-in + global kill-switch 5) small smoke-run before flip.
noah: add marker header when probe is active so service logs can correlate: X-RW-Shadow-Applied: shim_v1.
sasha: yes. comparer runs async diff: token_delta_pct, schema_mismatch_pct, semantic-score-delta. default thresholds: token <2, schema <0.5, semantic <4.
rita: how to roll forward from probe to apply? automated or manual?
sasha: default probe window 60m with rolling windows of 5m; if drift < thresholds for 3 consecutive windows, flag candidate. manual approval required by platform owner.
noah: CI test: ensure X-RW-Shadow header survives edge->origin and that comparer receives mirrored payload.
rita: ops: add PD route and a channel #shadow-alerts for drift spikes. ops-bot: queued alert integration check.
sasha: client SDKs stay server-side by default. expose a read-only header so advanced clients can skip transformation.
noah: also add metrics tag shadow=true and label shim_version. helps dashboards.
sasha: small runbook note: immediate revert triggers: error_rate>0.5% OR p95 latency +100ms OR semantic drift >10% in 5m.
rita: i can own the smoke harness and dashboards. noah: i'll wire comparer and CI test. sasha: i'll update the RFC appendix. leaving open 24h for comments. :eyes:
